meta.name: biopython
meta.description: Comprehensive molecular biology toolkit. Use for sequence manipulation, file parsing (FASTA/GenBank/PDB), phylogenetics, and programmatic NCBI/PubMed access (Bio.Entrez). Best for batch processing, custom bioinformatics pipelines, BLAST automation. For quick lookups use gget; for multi-service integration use bioservices.

copy.tagline: 处理分子生物学序列和自动分析生物信息数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理生物信息学数据，需要自动化分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Manipulate molecular sequences and automate bioinformatics analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly work with bioinformatics data and need automated analysis pipelines.

howto.what: Claude会调用Biopython库写Python代码，处理DNA/RNA/蛋白质序列，读取转换FASTA、GenBank等生物文件，访问NCBI数据库，做BLAST比对和进化树分析。
howto.when: 当你提到处理生物序列（如DNA、蛋白质）、解析FASTA/GenBank等文件、访问NCBI/PubMed数据库、做BLAST比对或构建进化树等任务时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude will write Python code using the Biopython library to handle biological sequences (DNA/RNA/protein), read and convert bioinformatics file formats, access NCBI databases, run BLAST searches, and build phylogenetic trees.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about biological sequence manipulation, parsing files like FASTA/GenBank, accessing NCBI/PubMed, running BLAST, building trees, or other bioinformatics tasks.
